item.title: Navi 0.3.2
item.description:
Ash 改名为 Navi。新版换了应用标识，没法从 Ash 里直接更新：点「了解更多」下载 Navi，拖进「应用程序」后打开一次，它会接过 Navi 的设置、数据和登录项，并把旧的 Ash.app 移到废纸篓。

  • chore(mac): 版本号 0.3.2
  • feat(mac): 一键发布同时支持 Apple 芯片和 Intel
  • feat: stream live computer-use window previews on macOS
  • feat(web): use solid unaccepted dots and unify status indicators at 6px
  • feat(web): compare task dots at 4 5 6 and 7 pixels
  • fix(mac): 对外版本显示隐藏内部构建号
  • feat(web): compare all task indicators at 4px and 7px
  • feat(web): show task dot colors and live motion side by side
  • feat(web): compare five unaccepted task dot styles
  • feat(web): compare three persistent acceptance indicators
  • fix: limit operation mini previews to computer use
  • feat(web): add interactive task indicator comparison demo
  • feat(mac): 通过 GitHub Actions 一键发布并维护固定下载页
  • fix(mac): wait for safe runtime handover without interrupting users
  • fix(web): restore full-width plan implementation row
  • feat: add compact computer previews and responsive browser layouts
